svg.aria-label: The source text G[0,2](p0 -> F[1,1]p1) and a semantic profile, closed, go into parse, which returns a FormulaDocument or a Diagnostic with one of 18 stable codes and a byte span. format_document turns the document into canonical text, G[0,2](p0->F[1,1]p1). Parsing that text again gives the same graph.
